steps.title: Program thermal cycler
steps.instruction: Set the qRT‑PCR instrument to run the following program: 50 °C for 5 min (1 X), 95 °C for 2 min (1 X), then 40 cycles of 95 °C for 3 sec, 60 °C for 30 sec with fluorescence acquisition at each cycle.

steps.title: Interpret amplification curves
steps.instruction: Assess each reaction’s fluorescence trace: it must display a sigmoidal shape (horizontal start, exponential rise, plateau), reach a fluorescence intensity comparable to the positive control, and cross a predefined threshold (CT) early in the log‑linear phase. A CT value ≤ 40 cycles is considered positive; a CT of exactly 40 cycles is considered negative. No‑template controls (NTCs) must not generate a curve.
